customer: Selling my pickup to Northwind. What happens with the plates? I'm in Dunmore and drive a lot for work, so I'll need plates on whatever I get next.
agent: Per our article "What to do with your license plates," take your plates off the pickup before you hand it over, and keep them. What you do with them afterward is up to your state's motor vehicle agency, so check with Dunmore's agency for the details. You can usually transfer them to your next car.
